items.message: @Roth.Θ_nonneg : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, 0 ≤ Roth.Θ B q r

theorem Roth.Θ_nonneg.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, 0 ≤ Roth.Θ B q r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B} q {r} ↦
  Real.sSup_nonneg fun x a ↦
    Exists.casesOn a fun R h ↦
      And.casesOn h fun left right ↦
        Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦
          And.casesOn h_1 fun left right ↦
            right ▸ Roth.index_nonneg ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r
THETANONNEG188_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ}, 0 ≤ Roth.Θ B q r
